html:
The Malak Malak are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in floodplain country along the lower Daly River, southwest of Darwin.

Their neighbours were the Kungarakany to the north, the Ngan'gimerri upriver and the Marrithiyel to the west. Their language is not part of the Pama-Nyungan family. In the 1880s copper miners and a Jesuit mission came to the Daly River. Malak Malak people later made one of the early claims under the Northern Territory land rights law of 1976. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Malak Malak are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, in floodplain country along the lower Daly River, southwest of Darwin.
